module: Identical fresh late/post-projector Abstractor: 2 layers, width 256, 4 heads, 128 pooled symbols; zero output initialization; no correction cap
direct_answer: Original 700x1016 sheet and PGM_PROMPT; native answer-letter-plus-ending causal CE; final greedy evaluation max16 tokens
candidate: Eight 520x520 completed matrices and PROMPT_TEXT; shared native LFM and Abstractor; FP32 logit(Yes)-logit(No); joint eight-way CE
exposure_policy: Every paired optimizer update sees the same 16 questions; rotate execution order; stop both at a common update before evaluation reserve
checkpoint_selection: Final common update; screens are monitoring only; no comparison of unlike loss values
limitations: Protocol bundles image layout, prompt and objective. One seed. Two hours includes checks/training/evaluation and may not complete an epoch. No automatic continuation.
